Reviewer view: the judge's full reasoning

To the rider and the driver. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee on trip TRP-02714 is refunded to the rider in full, and the platform pays the driver SGD 2.25 as a goodwill payment.

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 6.75 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It does not exceed the threshold, so the amount is executed automatically on issue, subject to POL-GEN-04.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

What each side argued

Rider advocate7 claim(s), 6 kept
  1. The charge rests on POL-NS-01, which is deliberately conjunctive, and limb (b) fails on the platform's own numbers. The driver's 97-fix trace yields derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count = 0 with a longest_qualifying_run of 0 fixes over 0.0 seconds, and his closest approach to the pickup pin anywhere in the trip was derived.driver_track.min_distance_m = 272.98 m. That is outside the 150 m arrival radius POL-NS-02 sets for a TRANSPORT_HUB pickup such as Bedok Interchange, and it is also the closest he ever got. A driver who never entered the pickup geofence never 'arrived' at the pickup point, and the 'I'm Here' tap at 09:19:17 cannot supply the arrival that limb (b) requires.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-NS-01, POL-NS-02
  2. POL-NS-02 states the consequence in terms: where the gps_trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes preceding the cancellation, the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. This is not a sparse-trace case where the test cannot be run - the trace has 100% coverage, 97 fixes at a 10 s cadence and no gaps, and there is no qualifying in-radius fix on it at all. The rider's SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is therefore refundable in full, and no driver compensation is payable on this limb.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-NS-02
  3. Independently of arrival, POL-NS-01 limb (c) requires a continuous in-geofence dwell of at least the free waiting period in force - 180 seconds on this trip, read from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec (no_show_threshold_sec is null) - and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full where the effective in-geofence dwell falls short. The measured dwell is 0.0 seconds (derived.arrival.longest_qualifying_run.duration_sec), a shortfall of 180.0 seconds (derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.shortfall_sec). Limb (i) of POL-NS-06 cannot help the driver: there were no in-geofence intervals to accumulate (derived.arrival.accumulated_dwell.run_count = 0), and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02714-01 is MISSING with admissibility status MISSING and weight_multiplier 0.0 - I rely on that artifact only for its absence, and no advisory covering this pickup road exists, so limb (i) is simply unavailable and the shortfall stands.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714, EV-ADVIS-02714-01 · POL-NS-06, POL-NS-01Discarded by the referee (IMPAIRMENT_UNDISCLOSED): the claim cites impaired artifact EV-ADVIS-02714-01 at weight_multiplier 0.0 but does not name its issue code(s): MISSING_ARTIFACT
  4. Even on the account most favourable to the driver - that he was stationary for the whole wait at a bay he believed was the pickup - the fee is still refunded in full. POL-NS-03 refunds the whole cancellation fee wherever the driver's stationary point lies outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but not more than 400 m from the pin, and his nearest point of 272.98 m (derived.driver_track.min_distance_m) sits inside that 400 m ceiling, while the rider's device stayed between 2.29 m and 9.36 m from the pin across 63 qualifying fixes (derived.rider_presence). POL-NS-03 changes only who bears the driver's loss - nothing, or a platform-funded goodwill payment under limb (ii) where registered_pickup_points is 2 and neither party named a sub-location - and that payment is charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. It does not change the rider's refund.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-NS-03
  5. Limb (d) also fails. It requires the driver's termination to fall at or after the moment the required dwell elapsed, and on this record no in-geofence dwell elapsed at all. The RIDER_NO_SHOW reason code the driver selected is contradicted by the rider's own track, which places the rider's device 2.29 m to 9.36 m from the pickup pin on 63 of 63 fixes - far inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m for a TRANSPORT_HUB - for the whole waiting window. The rider was at the pickup point; the driver was never nearer than 272.98 m to it. That is the opposite of a rider no-show, and the driver's statement that he waited at the pickup bay the app sent him to is not corroborated by a single fix in his own trace.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714, EV-CHAT-02714 · POL-NS-01
  6. The amount in issue is the cancellation-fee line only. EV-FARE-02714 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so the rider has paid the contested SGD 4.50 and nothing has been returned. On the facts above the remedy is FULL_REFUND of that line - under POL-GEN-03, the whole contested amount returned to the filing party - with driver_compensation_sgd nil where POL-NS-02 governs, and at most a platform-funded goodwill figure if POL-NS-03(ii) governs instead.EV-FARE-02714, EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-GEN-03, POL-NS-02
  7. I do not press POL-NS-04's rider-contact route, and I say so rather than stretch it: the driver replied to the rider's 09:20:57 message 'cant see you' at 09:21:47, fifty seconds later, so limb (b)'s 120-second silence is not met and the clause does not apply. Its own closing words send any residual mislocation to POL-NS-03, which on the distances set out above refunds the fee in full.EV-CHAT-02714, EV-GPS-02714 · POL-NS-04, POL-NS-03
Driver advocate7 claim(s), 7 kept
  1. The driver's closest recorded fix is 272.98 m from the pickup pin. That is short of the 150 m TRANSPORT_HUB arrival radius, so I do not put the driver's case on an in-geofence arrival; but it is inside the 400 m ceiling POL-NS-03 draws, and that is the band this trip falls into. On the only distance measure the record states, the driver was at the interchange precinct, not somewhere the trip never reached. The chat_log names no sub-location - the rider's single message is 'cant see you' and neither party names an entrance, block, tower or bay - so POL-NS-03 limb (i) does not strip the driver, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 2, so limb (ii) attributes the mislocation to pin ambiguity rather than to the driver and fixes a platform-funded goodwill payment of 50 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, SGD 2.25, charged to the platform and never recovered from the rider. I put the point no higher than this: the record carries no derived dwell figure for the 150 m to 400 m band, and the clause is nonetheless the only one on which the driver's money can stand.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714, EV-CHAT-02714 · POL-NS-03
  2. POL-NS-05 voids the arrival marker only on two stated numbers - distance over 300 m at the marker timestamp, or speed at or above 15 km/h. The only distance figure the record gives is derived.driver_track.min_distance_m = 272.98 m, short of the 300 m line, and the record carries no fix matched to the 09:19:17 'I'm Here' event from which the speed limb could be read. The false-marker finding is therefore not made out on this record, and POL-NS-05's own closing sentence sends a driver who marked arrival within 300 m of the pin but outside the arrival radius to POL-NS-03.EV-GPS-02714, EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-NS-05, POL-NS-03
  3. POL-NS-04 exonerates the rider only where the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of the rider's locating message and placed no in-app call. The chat_log times the rider's 'cant see you' at 09:20:57 and the driver's 'im here already, where are you' at 09:21:47 - 50 seconds - and the driver had already sent 'im here' at 09:19:47. Limb (b) fails on the clause's own arithmetic, so the clause does not apply 'regardless of the content of the reply', and by its closing sentence the residual mislocation is decided under POL-NS-03, not in the rider's favour.EV-CHAT-02714, EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-NS-04, POL-NS-03
  4. On the trip record the driver's 'I'm Here' tap at 09:19:17 is the arrival event POL-NS-01(a) asks for, and the trip ends with no boarding event and cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. The platform's own telemetry starts the free waiting period at 09:19:19 and terminates at 09:24:50 - 331 seconds, comfortably past the 180 second free wait in force for this trip under platform_policy - so the reason code and the running of the free wait are each carried by a COMPLETE, weight-1.0 platform record, and the driver cancelled only after the waiting period the fee pays for had elapsed.EV-TRIP-02714 · POL-NS-01
  5. Nothing in the profiles withholds the driver's money or forces review. POL-NS-07's anti-farming check needs driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d of 4 or more AND a rate above 0.08; this driver records 1 termination against 137 completed trips in 30 days, a rate of 0.007, so neither limb is met and compensation is not withheld on that ground. POL-NS-09(d) reads rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d, which is 0, and POL-NS-09(c) reads the two counterparty counts, both 0, so no repeat-abuse trigger fires either. The lifetime counters - prior_no_show_flags = 1 - are context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot be substituted for the 30-day figures.EV-DPROF-02714, EV-RPROF-02714 · POL-NS-07, POL-NS-09, POL-GEN-01
  6. Every artifact this brief rests on is COMPLETE with weight_multiplier 1.0 - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare ledger - so under POL-GEN-02(2) no finding on this trip is capped below the 0.70 confidence floor by admissibility weight and POL-NS-09(a) is not engaged. The fare ledger also reconciles: fare_breakdown.cancellation_fee is SGD 4.50, the same figure trip_record.platform_policy states, so no POL-NS-08(d) defect impairs the amount in dispute, and the driver's payout figure, where it is payable, is 80 percent of that net fee, SGD 3.60.EV-TRIP-02714, EV-GPS-02714, EV-CHAT-02714, EV-FARE-02714 · POL-GEN-02, POL-NS-08, POL-NS-07
  7. If the tribunal cannot resolve the position question, this case belongs in human review rather than in an automatic refund. Two admissible, weight-1.0 artifacts speak directly to arrival and disagree: trip_record records the 09:19:17 arrival marker and a 331 second wait, while gps_trace places the driver's nearest fix at 272.98 m and computes no in-geofence fix at all. POL-NS-05 is the only clause that tests a false marker, and its two numeric triggers are not made out on this record, so the disagreement is not closed by the clause it would take to close it. POL-NS-09(b) therefore applies on the alternative case, the fee is held rather than refunded while a human settles whether the driver held position in the band outside the 150 m radius and within 400 m, and no monetary ruling issues meanwhile.EV-TRIP-02714, EV-GPS-02714 · POL-NS-09, POL-NS-05

POL-NS-01(b) requires the GPS trace to place the driver inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB bay at or before the arrival event. EV-GPS-02714 is a complete trace — 97 fixes, 100% coverage, a 10 s cadence and no gaps — and it yields 0 qualifying fixes inside the radius; the driver's closest recorded approach to the pin anywhere in the trip was 272.98 m. The driver's 09:19:17 'I'm Here' tap is a status the driver set, not a platform measurement, and cannot supply the arrival limb (b) requires; nor do the 331 s wait timer or the RIDER_NO_SHOW code in EV-TRIP-02714 cure it. Limb (c) fails too: the effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force (platform_policy.free_wait_sec). Under POL-NS-02 the rider is entitled to a full refund of the SGD 4.50, and because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full no POL-NS-07 compensation (80% of the net fee, SGD 3.60) arises. Why the driver still receives SGD 2.25. POL-NS-03 governs where the driver's closest position is outside the 150 m arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin, and 272.98 m is inside that ceiling; the driver marked arrival while close to the pin but not inside the radius, and POL-NS-05's own closing words send that situation to POL-NS-03.
